source: derived: horizons marched over the global LOLA grid (0.5 degree cells, 30 cells, 24 azimuths); Sun and Earth directions from the JPL DE440 ephemerides every 6 h of 2027
note: Share of 2027 with the Sun AND the Earth above the regional horizon at the same time: the proxy of the useful hours (the Sun and Earth layers alone are marginals). Regional (15 km cells): terrain smaller than a cell is invisible, so rough ground is overstated. Not validated against NASA illumination products.
